title: weaver project
description: A project's tmux session, opened with `weave <project>`. See https://github.com/medilies/weaver#project-config

root.description: Directory the session is rooted at: absolute, or starting with ~/.

repositories.description: Git repositories expected under root, cloned when missing: directory relative to root ("." is root itself) → remote.

windows.description: Windows in order. Without any, the session opens one window named after the project.

env.description: Environment variables, set literally. A pane's override its project's.

runtimes.description: Toolchain versions put first on PATH. A pane's override its project's.

node.description: Node.js version installed by nvm, e.g. 20 for the newest 20.x.y.

php.description: PHP version installed side by side in /usr/bin, e.g. 8.4.

name.description: Window name, unique in the project.

panes.description: Panes in creation order: the first fills the window, each later one splits an earlier one. Without any, one shell in root.

name.description: Shown in the pane's top border. Required, and unique, when the window has several panes.

dir.description: Where the pane's shell starts: relative to root, or absolute.

command.description: Typed into the shell and run, so it stays in the shell history.

prefill.description: Typed at the prompt but not run: press Enter to run it.

note.description: Lines printed before the shell starts.

split.description: How the pane is made from an earlier one. Every pane but the first has one.

of.description: Name of the pane it splits. Default: the previous pane.

size.description: Share of the split pane: a percentage (40%) or cells (20). Default: half.
